proposal: The Mandate recommends abandoning the withdrawals of land from leasing in the Thompson Divide in Colorado, the 10-mile buffer around Chaco Culture National Historical Park in New Mexico, and the Boundary Waters area in Minnesota, if those withdrawals have not yet been completed. In the meantime it asks for the associated energy and mineral leases and permits in those areas to be revisited in consultation with state elected officials.

status_summary: All three withdrawals had been completed before 2025, so the Mandate's conditional request is matched only by later reversals. For the Boundary Waters, the House (2026-01-21, 214 to 208) and Senate (2026-04-16, 50 to 49) passed H.J.Res. 140, which the President signed on 2026-04-27 as Public Law 119-85, disapproving the 20-year withdrawal of about 225,504 acres. For Chaco, BLM took comment through 2026-07-29 on an assessment proposing full revocation of the 336,404 acre buffer withdrawal, with no final decision found. No federal action on the Thompson Divide withdrawal was found, though a February 2025 report said it could be reconsidered.

timeline.event: House passed H.J.Res. 140, the Congressional Review Act resolution disapproving Public Land Order 7917 (Boundary Waters area withdrawal), 214 to 208.
Senate passed H.J.Res. 140 without amendment, 50 to 49 (roll call 84).
President signed H.J.Res. 140, which became Public Law 119-85, disapproving the 2023 order that withdrew about 225,504 acres in Cook, Lake and Saint Louis Counties, Minnesota, for 20 years.
BLM opened comment, through 2026-07-29, on an environmental assessment whose proposed action would fully revoke Public Land Order 7923, the Chaco buffer withdrawal of about 336,404 acres.

title: Reverse mineral withdrawals at Thompson Divide, Chaco and the Boundary Waters
uncertainties: The 'completed' reading of the withdrawals relies on the Chaco and Boundary Waters sources describing them as 20-year orders and on a Colorado report that the Thompson Divide withdrawal was finalized in 2024. A Federal Register API search for Thompson Divide since 2025-01-20 returned no documents. A news report says Interior moved to restore the Twin Metals federal leases, but no dated primary record was found, so lease actions are not counted.
